name: studymate-ai
description: AI-Powered Study Assistant converting study notes into flashcards and interactive quizzes

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test:backend: node backend/tests/runValidationTests.js && node backend/tests/failureScenarios.test.js && node backend/tests/mistralProvider.test.js && node backend/tests/groqProvider.test.js
scripts.test:frontend: node frontend/tests/flashcardInteractions.test.js && node frontend/tests/quizInteractions.test.js && node frontend/tests/frontendErrorHandling.test.js && node frontend/tests/raceConditionProtection.test.js && node frontend/tests/applicationStates.test.js
